notes: 0.3.35：本机仓库与云端仓库都为空时只允许推送，并把这次推送做成「初始化推送」。之前只有一维判断——目录空就一律只让拉取；云端其实也空时，人就被卡死在一个推不上去、也没东西可拉的空转状态。现在仓库状态按「本机有没有内容 × 云端有没有分支」两维算，status 多给 remoteHeads / remoteEmpty 和 mode（ok / await-pull / await-init），面板徽标相应多一个「待初始化」。两边都空时按钮直接叫「初始化推送」，拉取置灰；执行时 sync.ps1 依次 git init → 补 origin → 把插件 runtime 的六个执行体拷进仓库根当骨架 → 写 profile\host-contract.json（本机客户端版本）→ capture 抓本机配置 → 提交 → push -u origin main。骨架必须一起推，否则远端只剩一份 settings、没有执行体，另一台机器 pull 下来跑不起来。云端空不空是 git ls-remote --heads 现算的（15 秒超时）；探不到就退回老规矩「只允许拉取」，不在盲状态下开推送；云端已有分支而本机还空则继续拒绝推送并提示先拉取。两处演练都跑过：临时空目录 + 临时空 bare 仓库一次推成（远端 main 上骨架与契约齐全），另造「云端有内容 + 本机空」的对照场景确认仍被拦住。自检也顺手修了一处环境耦合：仓库处在「等拉取/等初始化」时，依赖仓库内容的断言改为 SKIP，并补上初始化推送专属的断言，不再让自检结论被仓库状态带偏。
notesEn: 0.3.35: when both the local repo and the cloud are empty, push is the only allowed action and that push becomes "Initialize push". The judgement used to have one dimension - an empty folder meant pull only - which left people stuck when the cloud was empty too: nothing to pull, and push refused. Repo state now derives from two dimensions (does this machine have content, does the cloud have branches): status returns remoteHeads / remoteEmpty and a mode (ok / await-pull / await-init), and the panel badge gains "To initialize". With both sides empty the button literally reads "Initialize push" while Pull is greyed out; sync.ps1 then runs git init -> add origin -> copy the six execution bodies from the plugin runtime into the repo root as the skeleton -> write profile\host-contract.json (this machine client version) -> capture -> commit -> push -u origin main. The skeleton ships along, otherwise the remote would hold settings with no execution bodies and the next machine could not run it. "Is the cloud empty" is computed live via git ls-remote --heads (15 s timeout); if it cannot be determined the old pull-only rule applies, and no push is allowed on a blind reading. If the cloud already has branches while the local folder is empty, push stays refused with a pull-first hint. Both drills were run: a temp empty folder plus a temp empty bare repo pushed through in one go (skeleton and contract present on remote main), and a control scenario with cloud content plus an empty local folder still got blocked. The selftest also lost an environment coupling: assertions that need repo content now report SKIP while the repo is waiting for pull/initialize, and initialize-push assertions were added, so the verdict no longer depends on the repo state.
